sites.name: Vikram (Chandrayaan-2) impact site
sites.note: Imaged by LROC; the date is the NSSDC impact date, and the targeted area (70.8 S, 23.5 E) is not the crash point.

sites.name: Shiv Shakti point (Chandrayaan-3 Vikram)
sites.note: IAU named it Statio Shiv Shakti on 2024-03-19; NSSDC gives longitude to two decimals, and Wikipedia citing an ISRO brochure gives -69.373, 32.319.

sites.name: Odysseus (IM-1)
sites.note: Near Malapert A. The research note attributes these coordinates to Wikipedia (80 deg 08 min S, 1 deg 26 min E) and gives no separate NSSDC value; the lander tipped to about 30 degrees and lost power on 2024-02-29. Landing time is from Wikipedia.

sites.name: Athena (IM-2)
sites.note: NSSDC value; Wikipedia gives -84.7906, 29.1958. Press coverage says it tipped onto its side and lost power.

sites.name: Shackleton crater (centre)
sites.note: Feature centre from the USGS gazetteer, not a landing point; the page also lists -89.63, 132.32 and -89.90, 0.00 without labels.

sites.name: Shackleton-de Gerlache connecting ridge (LROC point)
sites.note: Point where the ridge meets the Shackleton rim, originally 196.739 E; a rim point, not the ridge centre or a landing site.

sites.name: Malapert Massif (Mons Malapert)
sites.note: USGS feature centre (name approved 2024-08-26), not a landing point.

sites.name: Mons Mouton
sites.note: Feature centre from Wikipedia (84 deg 36 min S, 31 deg 00 min E); the IM-2 touchdown is at -84.7906, 29.1957.

sites.name: Nobile (crater)
sites.note: Feature centre from Wikipedia (85 deg 17 min S, 53 deg 16 min E), not a rim or landing point.

sites.name: Haworth (crater)
sites.note: Feature centre from Wikipedia (86 deg 54 min S, 4 deg 00 min W), not a rim or landing point.

sites.name: de Gerlache (crater)
sites.note: Feature centre from Wikipedia (88 deg 30 min S, 87 deg 06 min W); the rim was not located.

sites.name: Faustini (crater)

sites.name: Cabeus (crater)
